units: <cite ref="Pesachim 101b:5">Pes. 101ᵇ</cite> <he>לק׳ קמא הדר</he> (some ed. <he>לקִיבְעֵיה</he>) he goes back (refers in his mind) to his first appointed place for the meal.

<cite ref="Zevachim 7b:1">Zeb. 7ᵇ</cite> top <he>מק׳ לא מכפרא וכ׳</he> a dedicated sin-offering does not effect pardon (for a sin of commission) directly by its dedication, but only by implication (when going along with a sin of omission).

<cite ref="Zevachim 6a:7">Ib. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>מק׳ לא מכפרא וכ׳</he> it (the designated meal offering left to heirs) has its pardoning effect not through appointment (as if the heirs had a share in it) but merely by implication, v. <cite ref="S00055"><he>קְבִיעוּתָא</he></cite>.
